test_cases.prompt: Set up this repo for the engineering skills.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes setup-matt-pocock-skills skill to configure issue tracker, triage labels, and domain doc layout.
test_cases.notes: Explicit setup request is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Configure the issue tracker for this project.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes setup-matt-pocock-skills skill to explore and configure the issue tracker (GitHub, GitLab, local, or other).
test_cases.notes: Issue tracker configuration is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: This is a monorepo. Set up multi-context domain docs.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes setup-matt-pocock-skills skill with monorepo detection, offering multi-context layout with CONTEXT-MAP.md.
test_cases.notes: Monorepo configuration is a valid trigger.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Setup configures the environment; implement builds features.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for building code.

test_cases.prompt: Process the incoming issues in the backlog.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes triage skill instead. Triage uses the tracker; setup-matt-pocock-skills configures the tracker.
test_cases.notes: triage is the sibling skill for issue processing.

test_cases.prompt: Build and sharpen the project's domain model.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes domain-modeling skill instead. Domain-modeling maintains CONTEXT.md; setup-matt-pocock-skills creates the layout.
test_cases.notes: domain-modeling is the sibling skill for glossary maintenance.

test_cases.prompt: Switch from GitHub to GitLab for issue tracking.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes setup-matt-pocock-skills skill to reconfigure the issue tracker. Edge case: tracker migration requires re-running setup with different provider, testing idempotency.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: tracker migration tests whether setup is idempotent and handles provider switching.
